title: NANSEN run record
description: That a method completed on an entity: one line of runs/<entityType>.runs.jsonl, which is only ever appended to. A pipeline step is done for an entity once its method has completed on it. Lines that cannot be read (a write cut short) are skipped.

task.description: The task that ran it, when it ran in the queue.

mark.description: Marked by hand, as dev's pipeline viewer's checkboxes: done (as if it had run), or undone (it no longer counts as completed on the entity, until it completes again). Lines count in the order they were appended.
